item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President itself immediately prohibits covered persons from making specified foreign capital transfers on and after the order’s effective date, subject to Commerce authorization; the legal consequence occurs by operation of this segment.","evidence":"is prohibited on or after the effective date of this Order"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"Although Commerce has discretion over repatriation requirements, the segment also mandates that the Secretary grant a specified exemption to institutions certified by the Board; that legal exemption is to be produced through later agency action.","evidence":"The Secretary of Commerce shall exempt from the provisions of this section 1"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The segment authorizes the Board and Commerce to decide whether and how to regulate, require repatriation, issue implementing instruments, redelegate authority, and coordinate; it does not itself select a particular later legal outcome.","evidence":"as each of them determines to be necessary or appropriate"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The segment requires interagency consultation and preserves existing delegations, both forms of internal executive coordination and authority management without changing private legal rights.","evidence":"shall consult as necessary and appropriate"}]}
